hero.headline: AI drafts the reply. You decide what goes out.
hero.subheadline: InnoPeak watches your Google Business Profile, drafts a reply to every new review, and routes anything risky straight to the person who should see it — approval is required by default, and nothing slips through unanswered.

mockup.reviewSnippet: Waited 40 minutes past our reservation with no apology. Food was fine but not worth it.
mockup.draftText: Marcus, I'm sorry about the wait and that no one acknowledged it — that's not the experience we want. I'd like to make this right; please reach out to me directly.

items: Escalations reach a real person in minutes
Works directly with your Google Business Profile

problem.heading: Replying to reviews doesn't scale by hand

items.title: Reviews pile up
items.description: Every new review is a decision: ignore it, or drop what you're doing to write a reply that sounds like your business, not a form letter.

items.title: One bad reply is public forever
items.description: A rushed or defensive response to a 1-star review does more damage than the review itself — and it never comes down.

items.title: Urgent reviews get buried
items.description: A review that needs a manager's attention looks the same in your inbox as a glowing five-star note — until it's too late.

howItWorks.heading: From new review to posted reply, in four steps
howItWorks.description: The same workflow every time, whether it's a five-star thank-you or a review that needs a careful response.

steps.title: Connect your Google Business Profile
steps.description: Connect your Google Business Profile location once, and InnoPeak starts polling for new reviews automatically.

steps.title: AI drafts a reply
steps.description: Every new review gets a reply drafted in your business's tone, referencing what the reviewer actually said.

steps.title: You approve, edit, or reject
steps.description: By default nothing reaches Google without a person signing off — edit a word or two, or reject it outright. Once you trust the drafts, switch on auto-reply for straightforward reviews; escalated ones always wait for you.

steps.title: Risky reviews escalate automatically
steps.description: A low rating or a blocked term routes straight to a responsible teammate by email or Teams — before it becomes a bigger problem.

features.heading: Everything you need to stay on top of reviews
features.description: Built around one rule: AI drafts, a human decides.

items.title: Review queue
items.description: Every new review in one place, filtered by status and classification, so nothing gets missed.

items.title: AI reply drafts
items.description: Drafted automatically for every review, in your voice. Nothing is posted until you approve it, unless you switch on auto-reply.

items.title: Versioned prompts & tone
items.description: Tune how the AI sounds and track whether an edit actually improved your approval rate.

items.title: Escalation alerts
items.description: Low ratings and blocked terms notify the right person immediately by email or Teams.

items.title: Performance dashboard
items.description: Track approval rate, rating trends, and how many reviews are still waiting on you.

items.title: Secure by design
items.description: Sign in with Microsoft SSO. Every business's data stays fully isolated from every other.

items.title: Auto-reply, when you're ready
items.description: Off by default. Turn it on and straightforward reviews get answered automatically — escalated ones still wait for a person, every time.

cta.heading: Stop choosing between fast replies and careful ones.
cta.description: Connect your Google Business Profile and let InnoPeak draft the first version — you always have the last word.

footer.tagline: AI-assisted replies for Google Business Profile reviews — always reviewed by a human before they go out.
